result_text:
A sub-landscape without a readable `config.json` no longer aborts the parent report. Its row renders with the link to its index page and the default landscape logo. It compiles, but I didn't run any tests or generate a report with a missing config.

The change is in `LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, in the sub-landscape table loop (around line 652). `getSubLandscapeConfig` already returned null when the file was missing or unreadable, and the next line dereferenced it. I now fall back to an empty `Metadata` when the config or its metadata is null. With no logo link set, the existing code already picks the default landscape icon. Sub-landscapes that do have a config still show their own logo, and the other rows are unaffected.
